description.value: Xwum LP is a Katzie First Nation-operated canoe rental company situated at the gateway to Pitt Lake and Widgeon Creek in Pitt Meadows, BC, on the nation's traditional territory known as sq̓ə́yc̓əyaʔɬ x̌acaʔ. Visitors can rent 2-person canoes to paddle through the protected wetlands of Widgeon Creek, hike to Widgeon Falls, or camp overnight at the Widgeon or Alouette Golden Ears campsites. The operation blends outdoor adventure with Indigenous cultural stewardship, including customized guided cultural tours available by advance booking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and explicitly says 'NOW OPEN!' with active booking pages, confirming the business is open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null. Address, phone, and email are taken from the website footer since the OSM record contains no contact details.
concerns: OSM record contains no osm_id, address, or phone number; address and phone sourced from website footer only.
Two phone numbers listed on website: Xwum LP Rentals 672-205-0964 and KDC Head Office 604-460-8837 — primary rental line used.
Minor price discrepancy between front page (overnight canoe $125) and offerings/bookings pages ($160); bookings page appears more current and detailed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Katzie First Nation canoe rental attraction at Pitt Lake with active online booking and clear contact information. A notable destination for touring cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact: canoerental@kdlp.ca. Group bookings and customized guided cultural tours available by advance arrangement.

wow_evidence: Katzie First Nation canoe rentals into Widgeon Creek wetlands and falls — a genuinely special paddle day; established Indigenous operator.
blurb: Katzie-run canoe rentals into the Widgeon Creek wetlands.
